ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached-House) District symbols and B3-1

Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 20-B in an area bound by:

East 83 Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South South Shore Drive; a line 58.50 feet south of

and parallel to East 83" Street; and South South Shore Drive.

To those of a B3-1 Community Shopping District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 8301-03 S South Shore Drive
